caption: The drawing shows a round metal strainer with a perforated bottom, depicted in graphite and colored pencil on a beige background with darker brown and tan shading around the central figure. The strainer has a detailed handle at the top with a curved and ornamental design, and two clasps or attachments along its rim on either side. Holes are evenly distributed in a circular pattern on the strainer's base. A side view labeled “SIDE ELEVATION” is sketched in simple outline above the main drawing, showing the profile of the object. In the lower right corner, text in pencil reads "STRAINER CASE-2  18799-16 SIZE-1” x 5”" with the artist’s name "H. BADER" signed at the very bottom. The drawing is rendered with shading to suggest depth and consists primarily of gray, black, and brown hues.
title: Silver Strainer
